title: The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. E

translated_title: 表示学习中协变量依赖与潜在结构之间的权衡
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16245v1 公告类型：新 摘要：解缠表示学习旨在寻找潜在表示，其中每个单独的维度与不同的协变量对齐。无监督方法通常以潜在维度独立性为目标，但这并不能保证生成的维度与语义上有意义的协变量对齐。监督方法利用观测到的协变量来构造潜在空间，但在协变量相关的情况下，它们无法同时控制一对一潜在-协变量对齐和潜在独立性。我们引入了一个统一的监督框架，该框架将潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构的约束相结合。在此框架内，我们展示了一种固有的权衡，其中强制执行潜在独立性或独占的一对一潜在-协变量依赖会以潜在-协变量对齐的可证明成本为代价。我们证明了由此产生的解缠机制按该对齐强度的顺序排列。
tldr: 本文提出一个统一监督框架，揭示了解缠表示学习中协变量对齐与潜在结构独立性之间存在固有权衡，并证明了不同解缠机制按对齐强度排序。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a unified supervised framework revealing an inherent trade-off between covariate alignment and latent structure independence in disentangled representation learning, and proves that resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by alignment strength.
